model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя разпределението на различни категории персонажи в кръгова диаграма, разделена на три основни сектора и множество подкатегории. Общият брой на включените сектори е 11. Секторът "Virtual Characters" е най-голям и заема приблизително 60% от диаграмата, оцветен е в различни нюанси на синьо и включва подкатегориите "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Movie Characters" и "Comic Characters". Секторът "Custom Characters" е втори по големина, заема около 20%, и е оцветен в розово. Секторът "Real Characters" е най-малък, заемащ приблизително 20%, и е оцветен в зелено, като включва подкатегориите "Influencers", "Actors", "Musicians", "Writers", "Athletes", "Artists" и "Scientists". Диаграмата включва етикети за всяка категория и подкатегория, но не съдържа легенда или проценти вътре в секторите. Секторите са визуално разделени, като основните категории са подчертани с по-тъмен цвят и по-големи шрифтове. Подкатегориите са подредени около основните сектори, без да са изрично свързани с тях чрез цветове или други визуални средства. Няма визуално подчертани или изместени сектори. Подкатегориите в рамките на основните сектори изглеждат подредени по определен начин, вероятно според техния размер или категория.
model_annotations.English: The chart represents the distribution of various character categories and subcategories. The chart is divided into 13 slices, with the inner circle containing three main categories: "Custom Characters" in red, occupying approximately 15%, "Real Characters" in green, making up around 20%, and "Virtual Characters" in blue, taking up about 65%. The outer circle further breaks down "Virtual Characters" into six subcategories, including "Comic Characters" in light blue (around 30%), "Movie Characters" (about 8%), "Teleplay Characters" (approximately 5%), "Novel Characters" (around 7%), and "Game Characters" (roughly 15%), all labeled outside the respective slices. The "Real Characters" category is divided into seven subcategories, labeled outside the slices and colored in different shades of green, including "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers", with proportions ranging from approximately 1% to 5%. The chart does not include a legend, but labels are provided for each slice. The slices are visually ordered, with the largest slice, "Virtual Characters", at the center, and the subcategories arranged around it.
model_annotations.German: The diagram is a nested pie chart that compares the distribution of various character categories. The chart consists of 13 segments in total, divided into two main categories: "Virtual Characters" and "Real Characters". The "Virtual Characters" category, represented by shades of blue and occupying roughly 70% of the chart, is further sub-divided into six segments: "Comic Characters" (approximately 30%), "Game Characters" (around 17%), "Novel Characters" (about 8%), "Teleplay Characters" (roughly 7%), "Movie Characters" (around 6%), and "Virtual Characters" (the central category itself, taking up about 40% of the inner circle). The "Real Characters" category, represented by shades of green and pink, occupies around 30% of the chart and is sub-divided into seven segments: "Custom Characters" (approximately 12%), "Influencers" (around 4%), "Actors" (about 3%), "Musicians" (roughly 3%), "Writers" (around 3%), "Athletes" (about 2%), "Artists" (approximately 2%), and "Scientists" (roughly 2%). The chart includes a visual hierarchy, with the inner circle highlighting the two main categories and the outer circle displaying the sub-categories. The segments are arranged in a radial pattern, with no explicit ordering or ranking.
